text: By the third night, the fire was the only thing keeping him alive.
The storm had buried the trail hours ago, and the temperature had dropped far below anything his gear was rated for.
He lay as close to the flames as he dared, listening to the wind carve through the valley, and tried not to think about how far the nearest road was.
All he could do now was wait for morning, and hope the fire lasted longer than the cold did.
